analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI attempts rebound after entering oversold, but ADX at 30.5 shows clear trend strength with uncertain direction. The price of 72,545 KRW is within the range between the swing support at 68,045 KRW and resistance at 80,380 KRW.
